seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in LaPlace, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in LaPlace and the River Parishes for 2026: the Festival of the Bonfires, the Christmas Eve bonfires and Destrehan Plantation.
lede: LaPlace sits in Louisiana's River Parishes, where Christmas means bonfires along the Mississippi levee, plantation Christmas events in Destrehan and a free holiday train concert on the railroad.
celebrates: Louisiana's River Parishes tourism site calls the area Bonfire Country. The season runs through December with a Spirit of Christmas light festival, a Norco Christmas parade and a Christmas Stroll, then the 37th Annual Festival of the Bonfires in Lutcher on December 11 to 13. The Christmas Eve bonfires on the levee are lit at 7 pm on December 24, and Destrehan Plantation adds A Candy Cane Celebration on December 13. The St. Joseph and Felicity Plantations also list a Cajun Bonfire Celebration on December 12, 19 and 26.
lastyear: In 2025 the CPKC Holiday Train brought a free concert to LaPlace on Tuesday, December 2, at 8:30 pm at the railroad crossing at 1801 W. Airline Highway, with guest artist Dylan Marlowe, according to St. John the Baptist Parish. L'Observateur also reported that Christmas on Main Street returned to 612 Main Street in LaPlace on December 13, 2025, from 3 to 8 pm with live performances and local vendors.
facts: Louisiana's River Parishes tourism site says local kids will tell you the bonfires light the way for Papa Noel to find all the good boys and girls of the River Parishes. It names Saint, a massive wooden alligator, as the Bonfire Country mascot, and the New Orleans tourism site says as many as 100 or more bonfires may be built along the levee in Gramercy, Lutcher and Paulina.
trains: The CPKC Holiday Train made a stop in LaPlace in 2025, with a free concert at the railroad crossing on West Airline Highway, according to St. John the Baptist Parish. We could not confirm a 2026 stop, so check the parish site. For more train fun in the New Orleans area, the New Orleans streetcars and the Louisiana Steam Train Association both have museum pages on this site.

faq: When are the Christmas Eve bonfires on the levee?

Louisiana's River Parishes tourism site says the bonfires are lit at 7 pm on December 24, 2026. The tradition centers on Gramercy, Lutcher and Paulina in St. James Parish, along the Mississippi River levee.
What is the Festival of the Bonfires?

It is the 37th annual Christmas festival in Lutcher, held December 11, 12 and 13, 2026, at Lutcher Recreational Park. The festival lists food, live entertainment, crafts, Santa's Very Merry Forest, carnival rides and a fireworks show.
Is there a free bus shuttle to the bonfire?
Yes. The festival's site lists a 7 pm lighting of a bonfire on the levee with a free bus shuttle, followed by an 8 pm bonfire on the festival grounds with an annual fireworks show.
Where can kids see Christmas at a plantation near LaPlace?
Destrehan Plantation lists The Spirit of Christmas and A Candy Cane Celebration, which the River Parishes calendar places on December 13. Both are listed on this page.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in LaPlace and the River Parishes for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (The Spirit of Christmas at Destrehan Plantation) through December 30, with the Norco Christmas Parade (December 6), the Festival of the Bonfires in Lutcher (December 11 to 13), Ballet Images' The Nutcracker in Luling (December 12 and 13) and the Christmas Eve Bonfires on the Levee (December 24) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in LaPlace

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in the River Parishes (3 new this round, 2 earlier, 2 moved from the New Orleans page)
  • 1 free event: the Norco Christmas Parade on December 6
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Very Merry Forest at the Festival of the Bonfires and the Toy and Gift Event letters to Santa in Luling (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Norco Christmas Parade (December 6), bonfire lightings on the levee on December 11 to 13 and December 24
  • Shows: Ballet Images' The Nutcracker at the Lafon Arts Center in Luling (December 12 and 13, $35)
  • Trains: none scheduled in 2026 that we could confirm; the CPKC Holiday Train stopped in LaPlace in 2025
  • Season: November 27 to December 30
